description: The image presents two hierarchical pie charts, or sunburst charts, comparing the distribution of topics between two different datasets or classifiers, with the left chart's title blurred and the right chart titled "FineWeb-Edu Classifier." Neither chart includes a separate legend; instead, category labels and numerical values, which appear to represent percentages, are placed directly inside the larger slices or connected to the smaller slices via pointing lines. In the left chart, the inner ring consists of Education 25 (mint green), History & Society 23 (orange), Health & Medicine 22 (light blue), Science 15 (pink), Tech & Engineer 12 (brown), and Fin & Law 3 (cyan). Its corresponding outer ring includes Teaching & resources 15 and Science & technology education 10 (mint green); Diseases 11, Medical 6, and Nutrition 5 (light blue); Animal & Plant 13 and Materials 2 (pink); Society & culture 10, Historical review 7, and Events & people 6 (orange); Infor tech 5, Emerging tech 4, Materials 3, and Manage 2 (brown); and Policy 1 (cyan). In the right chart, the inner ring contains Education 38 (mint green), Health & Medicine 19 (light blue), History & Society 19 (orange), Science 15 (pink), Tech & Engineer 8 (brown), and a minimal cyan slice labeled "...". The right chart's outer ring comprises Science & technology education 19, Teaching & resources 17, and Healthy education 2 (mint green); Diseases 10, Nutrition 7, and Medical 2 (light blue); Animal & Plant 12 and Materials 3 (pink); Historical review 12, Society & culture 5, and Events & people 2 (orange); Emerging tech 4, Infor tech 3, and Materials 1 (brown); and Manage 1 (cyan).
